kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference
kev_entries.short_description: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an improper restriction of XML external entity (XXE) vulnerability in the mailboxd component.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Command Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) allows an attacker to inject memcache commands into a targeted instance which causes an overwrite of arbitrary cached entries.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Arbitrary File Upload Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains flaw in the mboximport functionality, allowing an authenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files to perform remote code execution. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2022-37042 which allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability by allowing an endpoint URL to accept parameters without sanitizing.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in MailboxImportServlet. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2022-27925 which allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Arbitrary File Upload Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) allows an attacker to upload arbitrary files using cpio package to gain incorrect access to any other user accounts.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted script to the /h/autoSaveDraft function.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability impacting the confidentiality and integrity of data.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Zimbra Collaboration contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the CalendarInvite feature of the Zimbra webmail classic user interface. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability via an email message containing a crafted calendar header, leading to the execution of arbitrary JavaScript code.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Command Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an unspecified vulnerability in the postjournal service that may allow an unauthenticated user to execute commands.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Cross-site Scripting Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that exists in the Classic Web Client due to insufficient sanitization of HTML content in ICS files. When a user views an e-mail message containing a malicious ICS entry, its embedded JavaScript executes via an ontoggle event inside a tag. This allows an attacker to run arbitrary JavaScript within the victim's session, potentially leading to unauthorized actions such as setting e-mail filters to redirect messages to an attacker-controlled address. As a result, an attacker can perform unauthorized actions on the victim's account, including e-mail redirection and data exfiltration.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Cross-site Scripting Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that could allow attackers to execute arbitrary JavaScript within the user's session, potentially leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Classic UI where attackers could abuse Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) @import directives in email HTML.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
kev_entries.short_description: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to send specially crafted SMTP requests that may result in execution of arbitrary operating system commands as the Zimbra user.

kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: SysAid On-Prem contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability in the Checkin processing functionality, allowing for administrator account takeover and file read primitives.

kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: SysAid Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: SysAid Server (on-premises version) contains a path traversal vulnerability that leads to code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: TanStack Unspecified Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: TanStack contains an unspecified vulnerability that allowed malicious versions of the product to be published to the npm registry to publish credential-stealing malware under a trusted identity.
kev_entries.notes: This vulnerability could affect an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products. For more information, please see: https://github.com/TanStack/router/security/advisories/GHSA-g7cv-rxg3-hmpx ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-45321

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: TeamT5 ThreatSonar Anti-Ransomware Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: TeamT5 ThreatSonar Anti-Ransomware contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability. ThreatSonar Anti-Ransomware does not properly validate the content of uploaded files. Remote attackers with administrator privileges on the product platform can upload malicious files, which can be used to execute arbitrary system commands on the server.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: TeamViewer Desktop Bypass Remote Login Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: TeamViewer Desktop allows for bypass of remote-login access control because the same AES key is used for different customers' installations. If an attacker were to know this key, they could decrypt protected information stored in registry or configuration files or decryption of the Unattended Access password to the system (which allows for remote login to the system).

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Teclib GLPI Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Teclib GLPI contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the third-party library, htmlawed.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: TeleMessage TM SGNL Hidden Functionality Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: TeleMessage TM SGNL contains a hidden functionality vulnerability in which the archiving backend holds cleartext copies of messages from TM SGNL application users.
kev_entries.notes: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions. Absent mitigating instructions from the vendor, discontinue use of the product. ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-47729

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: TeleMessage TM SGNL Initialization of a Resource with an Insecure Default Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: TeleMessage TM SGNL contains an initialization of a resource with an insecure default vulnerability. This vulnerability relies on how the Spring Boot Actuator is configured with an exposed heap dump endpoint at a /heapdump URI.
kev_entries.notes: It is recommended that mitigations be applied per vendor instructions if available. If these instructions cannot be located or if mitigations are unavailable, discontinue use of the product. ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-48927

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: TeleMessage TM SGNL Exposure of Core Dump File to an Unauthorized Control Sphere Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: TeleMessage TM SGNL contains an exposure of core dump file to an unauthorized control sphere Vulnerability. This vulnerability is based on a JSP application in which the heap content is roughly equivalent to a "core dump" in which a password previously sent over HTTP would be included in this dump.
kev_entries.notes: It is recommended that mitigations be applied per vendor instructions if available. If these instructions cannot be located or if mitigations are unavailable, discontinue use of the product. ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-48928

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX Unrestricted File Upload Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Telerik.Web.UI in Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX allows remote attackers to perform arbitrary file uploads or execute arbitrary code.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX Insecure Direct Object Reference Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in RadAsyncUpload that can result in file uploads in a limited location and/or remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Tenda AC11 Router Stack Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Tenda AC11 devices contain a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in /goform/setmac which allows attackers to execute code via a crafted post request.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute system commands via the deviceName POST parameter.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 devices contain a command injection vulnerability due to  the "formsetUsbUnload" function executes a dosystemCmd function with untrusted input. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute OS commands via a crafted goform/setUsbUnload request.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: TerraMaster OS Remote Command Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: TerraMaster OS contains a remote command execution vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to execute commands on the target endpoint.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: ThinkPHP "noneCms" Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: ThinkPHP "noneCms" contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution through crafted use of the filter parameter.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: ThinkPHP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: ThinkPHP contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via public//?s=index/\think\app/invokefunction&function=call_user_func_array&vars[0]=system&vars[1][]= followed by the command.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: TIBCO JasperReports Library Directory Traversal Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: TIBCO JasperReports Library contains a directory-traversal vulnerability that may allow web server users to access contents of the host system.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: TIBCO JasperReports Server Information Disclosure Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: TIBCO JasperReports Server contain a vulnerability which may allow any authenticated user read-only access to the contents of the web application, including key configuration files.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: tj-actions/changed-files GitHub Action Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations as set forth in the CISA instructions linked below. Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: tj-actions/changed-files GitHub Action contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to discover secrets by reading Github Actions Workflow Logs. These secrets may include, but are not limited to, valid AWS access keys, GitHub personal access tokens (PATs), npm tokens, and private RSA keys.
kev_entries.notes: This vulnerability affects a common open-source project, third-party library, or a protocol used by different products. For more information, please see: CISA Mitigation Instructions: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2025/03/18/supply-chain-compromise-third-party-tj-actionschanged-files-cve-2025-30066-and-reviewdogaction ; Additional References: https://github.com/tj-actions/changed-files/blob/45fb12d7a8bedb4da42342e52fe054c6c2c3fd73/README.md?plain=1#L20-L28 ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-30066

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: TP-Link Archer AX-21 Command Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: TP-Link Archer AX-21 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: TP-Link Multiple Archer Devices Directory Traversal Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Directory traversal vulnerability in multiple TP-Link Archer devices allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a .. (dot dot) in the PATH_INFO to login/.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: TP-Link Multiple Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: TP-Link TL-WR940N V2/V4, TL-WR841N V8/V10, and TL-WR740N V1/V2 contain a command injection vulnerability via the component /userRpm/WlanNetworkRpm. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: TP-Link Archer C7(EU) and TL-WR841N/ND(MS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: TP-Link Archer C7(EU) and TL-WR841N/ND(MS) contain an OS command injection vulnerability that exists in the Parental Control page. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: TP-link TL-WA855RE Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: TP-link TL-WA855RE contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker (on the same network) to submit a TDDP_RESET POST request for a factory reset and reboot. The attacker can then obtain incorrect access control by setting a new administrative password. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: TP-Link TL-WR841N Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: TP-Link TL-WR841N contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default, leading to the disclose of stored credentials. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Treck TCP/IP stack Out-of-Bounds Read Vulnerability

kev_entries.notes: Note that while it is possible to change the default password, implementors are encouraged to remove affected controllers from public networks and update the affected firmware: https://downloads.unitronicsplc.com/Sites/plc/Technical_Library/Unitronics-Cybersecurity-Advisory-2023-001-CVE-2023-6448.pdf;   https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-6448

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Unraid Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Unraid contains a vulnerability due to the insecure use of the extract PHP function that can be abused to execute remote code as root. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5849 for initial access.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Unraid Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Unraid contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to gain access to the administrative interface. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5847 for remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: vBulletin PHP Module Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via the widgetConfig[code] parameter in an ajax/render/widget_php routestring request.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: vBulletin PHP Module Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via crafted subWidgets data in an ajax/render/widget_tabbedcontainer_tab_panel request. This CVE ID resolves an incomplete patch for CVE-2019-16759.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Veeam Backup & Replication Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: The Veeam Distribution Service in the Backup & Replication application allows unauthenticated users to access internal API functions. A remote attacker can send input to the internal API which may lead to uploading and executing of malicious code.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Veeam Backup & Replication Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: The Veeam Distribution Service in the Backup & Replication application allows unauthenticated users to access internal API functions. A remote attacker can send input to the internal API which may lead to uploading and executing of malicious code.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Veeam Backup & Replication Cloud Connect Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Veeam Backup & Replication Cloud Connect component contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user operating within the backup infrastructure network perimeter to obtain encrypted credentials stored in the configuration database. This may lead to an attacker gaining access to the backup infrastructure hosts.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Veeam Backup and Replication Deserialization Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Veeam Backup and Replication contains a deserialization vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to perform remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Veritas Backup Exec Agent File Access Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Veritas Backup Exec (BE) Agent contains a file access vulnerability that could allow an attacker to specially craft input parameters on a data management protocol command to access files on the BE Agent machine.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Veritas Backup Exec Agent Improper Authentication Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Veritas Backup Exec (BE) Agent contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker unauthorized access to the BE Agent via SHA authentication scheme.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Veritas Backup Exec Agent Command Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Veritas Backup Exec (BE) Agent contains a command execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to use a data management protocol command to execute a command on the BE Agent machine.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Versa Concerto Improper Authentication Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Versa Concerto SD-WAN orchestration platform contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the Traefik reverse proxy configuration, allowing at attacker to access administrative endpoints. The internal Actuator endpoint can be leveraged for access to heap dumps and trace logs.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Versa Director Dangerous File Type Upload Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: The Versa Director GUI contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows administrators with Provider-Data-Center-Admin or Provider-Data-Center-System-Admin privileges to customize the user interface. The “Change Favicon” (Favorite Icon) enables the upload of a .png file, which can be exploited to upload a malicious file with a .png extension disguised as an image.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Vite Vitejs Improper Access Control Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Vite Vitejs contains an improper access control vulnerability that exposes content of non-allowed files using ?inline&import or ?raw?import. Only apps explicitly exposing the Vite dev server to the network (using --host or server.host config option) are affected.
kev_entries.notes: This vulnerability could affect an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products. For more information, please see: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/59673137c45ac2bcfad1170d954347c1a17ab949 ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-31125

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Vmware Aria Operations for Networks Command Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: VMware Aria Operations for Networks (formerly vRealize Network Insight) contains a command injection vulnerability that allows a malicious actor with network access to perform an attack resulting in remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware ESXi OpenSLP Use-After-Free Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: VMware ESXi OpenSLP contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an attacker residing in the management network with access to port 427 to perform remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware ESXi Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: VMware ESXi contains an authentication bypass vulnerability. A malicious actor with sufficient Active Directory (AD) permissions can gain full access to an ESXi host that was previously configured to use AD for user management by re-creating the configured AD group ('ESXi Admins' by default) after it was deleted from AD.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware ESXi Arbitrary Write Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: VMware ESXi contains an arbitrary write vulnerability. Successful exploitation allows an attacker with privileges within the VMX process to trigger an arbitrary kernel write leading to an escape of the sandbox.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware ESXi and Workstation TOCTOU Race Condition Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: VMware ESXi and Workstation contain a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that leads to an out-of-bounds write. Successful exploitation enables an attacker with local administrative privileges on a virtual machine to execute code as the virtual machine's VMX process running on the host.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware ESXi, Workstation, and Fusion Information Disclosure Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: VMware ESXi, Workstation, and Fusion contain an information disclosure vulnerability due to an out-of-bounds read in HGFS. Successful exploitation allows an attacker with administrative privileges to a virtual machine to leak memory from the vmx process.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: VMware Fusion, Remote Console (VMRC) for Mac, and Horizon Client for Mac contain a privilege escalation vulnerability due to improper use of setuid binaries that allows attackers to escalate privileges to root.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Multiple VMware Products Command Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: VMware Workspace One Access, Access Connector, Identity Manager, and Identity Manager Connector contain a command injection vulnerability. An attacker with network access to the administrative configurator on port 8443 and a valid password for the configurator administrator account can execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: VMware Workspace ONE Access, Identity Manager and vRealize Automation contain a privilege escalation vulnerability due to improper permissions in support scripts.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware SD-WAN Edge by VeloCloud Command Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: VMware SD-WAN Edge by VeloCloud contains a command injection vulnerability in the local web UI component. Successful exploitation of this issue could result in remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware Spring Cloud Gateway Code Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Spring Cloud Gateway applications are vulnerable to a code injection attack when the Gateway Actuator endpoint is enabled, exposed and unsecured.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Spring Framework JDK 9+ Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Spring MVC or Spring WebFlux application running on JDK 9+ may be vulnerable to remote code execution (RCE) via data binding.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware Tools Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: VMware Tools contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the vgauth module. A fully compromised ESXi host can force VMware Tools to fail to authenticate host-to-guest operations, impacting the confidentiality and integrity of the guest virtual machine. An attacker must have root access over ESXi to exploit this vulnerability.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware vCenter Server Information Disclosure Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: VMware vCenter Server contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service (vmdir) when the Platform Services Controller (PSC) does not correctly implement access controls. Successful exploitation allows an attacker with network access to port 389 to extract sensitive information.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware vCenter Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: VMware vCenter Server vSphere Client contains a remote code execution vulnerability in a vCenter Server plugin which allows an attacker with network access to port 443 to execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware vCenter Server Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: VMware vSphere Client contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Virtual SAN Health Check plug-in, which is enabled by default in vCenter Server, which allows for remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware vCenter Server File Upload Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: VMware vCenter Server contains a file upload vulnerability in the Analytics service that allows a user with network access to port 443 to execute code.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware vCenter Server Improper Access Control
kev_entries.short_description: Rhttproxy as used in vCenter Server contains a vulnerability due to improper implementation of URI normalization.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware vCenter Server Incorrect Default File Permissions Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: VMware vCenter Server contains an incorrect default file permissions vulnerability that allows a remote, privileged attacker to gain access to sensitive information.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware vCenter Server Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: VMware vCenter Server contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the implementation of the DCERPC protocol that allows an attacker to conduct remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware vCenter Server Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: VMware vCenter Server contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the implementation of the DCERPC protocol. This vulnerability could allow an attacker with network access to the vCenter Server to execute remote code by sending a specially crafted packet.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware vCenter Server Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: VMware vCenter contains an improper check for dropped privileges vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an attacker with network access to the vCenter Server to escalate privileges to root by sending a specially crafted packet.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware vCenter Server and Cloud Foundation Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: VMware vCenter Server and Cloud Foundation Server contain a SSRF vulnerability due to improper validation of URLs in a vCenter Server plugin. This allows for information disclosure.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware ESXi and Horizon DaaS OpenSLP Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: VMware ESXi and Horizon Desktop as a Service (DaaS) OpenSLP contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker with network access to port 427 to overwrite the heap of the OpenSLP service to perform remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware Server Side Request Forgery in vRealize Operations Manager API
kev_entries.short_description: Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in vRealize Operations Manager API prior to 8.4 may allow a malicious actor with network access to the vRealize Operations Manager API to perform a SSRF attack to steal administrative credentials.

kev_entries.product: Workspace ONE Access and Identity Manager
kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware Workspace ONE Access and Identity Manager Server-Side Template Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: VMware Workspace ONE Access and Identity Manager allow for remote code execution due to server-side template injection.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware Tanzu Spring Cloud Function Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: When using routing functionality in VMware Tanzu's Spring Cloud Function, it is possible for a user to provide a specially crafted SpEL as a routing-expression that may result in remote code execution and access to local resources.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware Tanzu Spring Cloud Config Directory Traversal Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Spring, by VMware Tanzu, Cloud Config contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows applications to serve arbitrary configuration files.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: VMware Tanzu Spring Data Commons Property Binder Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Spring Data Commons contains a property binder vulnerability which can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: WatchGuard Firebox Out of Bounds Write Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: WatchGuard Fireware OS iked process contains an out of bounds write vulnerability in the OS iked process. This vulnerability may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code and affects both the mobile user VPN with IKEv2 and the branch office VPN using IKEv2 when configured with a dynamic gateway peer.
kev_entries.notes: Check for signs of potential compromise on all internet accessible instances after applying mitigations. For more information please see: https://www.watchguard.com/wgrd-psirt/advisory/wgsa-2025-00027 ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-14733

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: WatchGuard Firebox Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: WatchGuard Firebox contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the OS iked process that may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: WatchGuard Firebox and XTM Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: WatchGuard Firebox and XTM appliances allow a remote attacker with unprivileged credentials to access the system with a privileged management session via exposed management access.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: WatchGuard Firebox and XTM Appliances Arbitrary Code Execution
kev_entries.short_description: On WatchGuard Firebox and XTM appliances, an unauthenticated user can execute arbitrary code.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Wazuh Server Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Wazuh contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for remote code execution on Wazuh servers.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: WebKitGTK Memory Corruption Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: WebKitGTK contains a memory corruption vulnerability which can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Webmin Command Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: An issue was discovered in Webmin. The parameter old in password_change.cgi contains a command injection vulnerability.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: WebPros cPanel & WHM and WP2 (WordPress Squared) Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: WebPros cPanel & WHM (WebHost Manager) and WP2 (WordPress Squared) contain an authentication bypass vulnerability in the login flow that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain unauthorized access to the control panel.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: WebRTC Heap Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: WebRTC, an open-source project providing web browsers with real-time communication, contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform shellcode execution. This vulnerability impacts web browsers using WebRTC including but not limited to Google Chrome.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Widget Factory Joomla Content Editor Improper Access Control Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
kev_entries.short_description: Widget Factory Joomla Content Editor contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow for upload and execution of PHP code via the creation of new editor profiles for unauthenticated users.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Wing FTP Server Improper Neutralization of Null Byte or NUL Character Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Wing FTP Server contains an improper neutralization of null byte or NUL character vulnerability that can allow injection of arbitrary Lua code into user session files. This can be used to execute arbitrary system commands with the privileges of the FTP service (root or SYSTEM by default).

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Wing FTP Server Information Disclosure Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Wing FTP Server contains a generation of error message containing sensitive information vulnerability when using a long value in the UID cookie.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: WordPress Core SQL Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
kev_entries.short_description: WordPress Core contains a SQL injection vulnerability when a plugin or theme passes untrusted input to the parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-63030 to allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain remote code execution on default WordPress installations.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: WordPress Core Interpretation Conflict Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
kev_entries.short_description: WordPress Core contains an interpretation conflict vulnerability that could allow an attacker to perform SQL Injection and achieve Remote Code Execution. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-60137.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
kev_entries.short_description: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: WordPress File Manager Plugin Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: WordPress File Manager plugin contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to execute PHP code and upload malicious files on a target site.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: WordPress Snap Creek Duplicator Plugin File Download Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: WordPress Snap Creek Duplicator plugin contains a file download vulnerability when an administrator creates a new copy of their site that allows an attacker to download the generated files from their Wordpress dashboard. This vulnerability affects Duplicator and Dulplicator Pro.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: WordPress Social Warfare Plugin Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: WordPress Social Warfare plugin contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability affects Social Warfare and Social Warfare Pro.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: WSO2 Multiple Products Unrestrictive Upload of File Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Multiple WSO2 products allow for unrestricted file upload, resulting in remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
kev_entries.short_description: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: XStream Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: XStream contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate the processed input stream and replace or inject objects that result in the execution of a local command on the server. This vulnerability can affect multiple products, including but not limited to VMware Cloud Foundation.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: XWiki Platform Eval Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: XWiki Platform contains an eval injection vulnerability that could allow any guest to perform arbitrary remote code execution through a request to SolrSearch.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Yealink Device Management Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Yealink Device Management contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Yiiframework Yii Improper Protection of Alternate Path Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Yii Framework contains an improper protection of alternate path vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code. This vulnerability could affect other products that implement Yii, including—but not limited to—Craft CMS, as represented by CVE-2025-32432.
kev_entries.notes: This vulnerability affects a common open-source component, third-party library, or a protocol used by different products. For more information, please see: https://www.yiiframework.com/news/709/please-upgrade-to-yii-2-0-52 ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-58136

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zabbix Frontend Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Unsafe client-side session storage leading to authentication bypass/instance takeover via Zabbix Frontend with configured SAML.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zabbix Frontend Improper Access Control Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Malicious actors can pass step checks and potentially change the configuration of Zabbix Frontend.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
kev_entries.short_description: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
kev_entries.short_description: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: ZK Framework AuUploader Unspecified Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: ZK Framework AuUploader servlets contain an unspecified vulnerability that could allow an attacker to retrieve the content of a file located in the web context. The ZK Framework is an open-source Java framework. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to ConnectWise R1Soft Server Backup Manager.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: ZKTeco BioTime Path Traversal Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: ZKTeco BioTime contains a path traversal vulnerability in the iclock API that allows an unauthenticated attacker to read arbitrary files via supplying a crafted payload.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zoho Desktop Central Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Zoho Desktop Central contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code in the Desktop Central MSP server.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) File Upload Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote users to upload files via login page customization.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central File Upload Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central contains a file upload vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus contains an authentication bypass vulnerability affecting the REST API URLs which allow for remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus contains an unspecified vulnerability allowing for remote code execution when performing a password change or reset.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zoho ManageEngine Multiple Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Zoho ManageEngine PAM360, Password Manager Pro, and Access Manager Plus contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zoho ManageEngine Multiple Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Multiple Zoho ManageEngine products contain an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability due to the usage of an outdated third-party dependency, Apache Santuario.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus before 11302 is vulnerable to authentication bypass that allows a few REST-API URLs without authentication

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus before 11306, ServiceDesk Plus MSP before 10530, and SupportCenter Plus before 11014 are vulnerable to unauthenticated remote code execution

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zyxel DSL CPE OS Command Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization if a current mitigation is unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Multiple Zyxel DSL CPE devices contain a post-authentication command injection vulnerability in the CGI program that could allow an authenticated attacker to execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zyxel DSL CPE OS Command Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization if a current mitigation is unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Multiple Zyxel DSL CPE devices contain a post-authentication command injection vulnerability in the management commands that could allow an authenticated attacker to execute OS commands via Telnet.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zyxel EMG2926 Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Zyxel EMG2926 routers contain a command injection vulnerability located in the diagnostic tools, specifically the nslookup function. A malicious user may exploit numerous vectors to execute malicious commands on the router, such as the ping_ip parameter to the expert/maintenance/diagnostic/nslookup URI.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
kev_entries.short_description: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zyxel Multiple Firewalls OS Command Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: A command injection vulnerability in the CGI program of some Zyxel firewall versions could allow an attacker to modify specific files and then execute some OS commands on a vulnerable device.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zyxel Multiple Firewalls OS Command Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Zyxel ATP, USG FLEX, VPN, and ZyWALL/USG firewalls allow for improper error message handling which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute OS commands remotely by sending crafted packets to an affected device.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zyxel Multiple Firewalls Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Zyxel ATP, USG FLEX, USG FLEX 50(W), USG20(W)-VPN, VPN, and ZyWALL/USG firewalls contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in the notification function that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause denial-of-service (DoS) conditions and remote code execution on an affected device.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zyxel Multiple Firewalls Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Zyxel ATP, USG FLEX, USG FLEX 50(W), USG20(W)-VPN, VPN, and ZyWALL/USG firewalls contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in the ID processing function that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause denial-of-service (DoS) conditions and remote code execution on an affected device.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zyxel Multiple Firewalls Path Traversal Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Multiple Zyxel firewalls contain a path traversal vulnerability in the web management interface that could allow an attacker to download or upload files via a crafted URL.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zyxel Multiple NAS Devices OS Command Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Multiple Zyxel network-attached storage (NAS) devices contain a pre-authentication command injection vulnerability, which may allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zyxel Multiple NAS Devices Command Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Multiple Zyxel network-attached storage (NAS) devices contain a pre-authentication command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute commands remotely via a crafted HTTP request.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zyxel Multiple Products Use of Hard-Coded Credentials Vulnerability
kev_entries.short_description: Zyxel firewalls (ATP, USG, VM) and AP Controllers (NXC2500 and NXC5500) contain a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability in an undocumented account ("zyfwp") with an unchangeable password.

kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zyxel P660HN-T1A Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_entries.short_description: Zyxel P660HN-T1A routers contain a command injection vulnerability in the Remote System Log forwarding function, which is accessible by an unauthenticated user and exploited via the remote_host parameter of the ViewLog.asp page.
